stories.text: Binance halts trading in France after missing MiCA deadline
stories.summary: Binance suspended crypto trading in France and several EU countries after failing to secure a MiCA license, impacting around 2 million users.

stories.text: Hackers drain $6M from DeFi protocol Summer.fi
stories.summary: Blockaid detected a live exploit on Summer.fi that drained $6 million, causing the SUMR token to drop despite a broader market uptrend.

stories.text: Ripple's Luxembourg license upgraded to fully compliant
stories.summary: Ripple's preliminary crypto asset provider license in Luxembourg was upgraded to full compliance, allowing it to serve clients across the European Economic Area.

stories.text: South Korea's Bitplanet to invest $10M in Bitcoin mining
stories.summary: South Korea's Bitplanet plans to deploy $10 million into Bitcoin mining operations in Oman and Paraguay to generate recurring BTC production.

stories.text: Vitalik says next Ethereum upgrade rivals the Merge
stories.summary: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin announced the network's next major overhaul, called 'Lean Ethereum,' will take three to four years and match the Merge's impact.
